summary: IQM Quantum Computers Oyj filed a Form 6-K reporting completion of its business combination with Real Asset Acquisition Corp. (RAAQ), a Nasdaq-listed SPAC. Under the definitive agreement, RAAQ merged with IQM US LLC, with IQM issuing 14,381,747 existing shares to RAAQ shareholders via ADSs (symbol: IQMX). RAAQ warrants were assumed as IQM Warrants (symbol: IQMX WS) with an $11.50 exercise price. Concurrently, a PIPE investment of 14,548,000 shares was placed with institutional investors. The transactions closed July 1, 2026, with Nasdaq trading starting July 2, 2026, and Nasdaq Helsinki trading expected July 3, 2026. Board appointments included Juho Sarvikas and Jeff Tuder. Watch for trading liquidity and warrant overhang.
